status: Fixed modeled-road-position adapter semantics before implementation/tests or new route evaluation
input: Trusted geometric position: existing canonical physical arc, retained segment ordinal, fraction in [0,1]. Derive both paid progress lanes from the audited packet; do not trust caller-supplied progress or coordinate equality to merge identities.
endpoints: Only first segment/fraction 0 and final segment/fraction 1 are true graph vertices. An interior quantized zero/full prefix is not a junction. Adjacent representations of a retained point normalize by segment+fraction; coincident points at different source positions remain distinct.
source: Canonical direction pays ceil(full encoded ticks * remaining forward progress); active physical reverse pays ceil(reverse full ticks * backward progress). No invented reverse or free change of physical span. True graph endpoints use existing vertex-source semantics.
target: Canonical direction pays ceil(full encoded ticks * forward progress); active reverse pays ceil(reverse full ticks * remaining backward progress). Existing signal, barrier, turn and reversal rules continue at graph vertices.
samePhysicalSpan: A direct candidate uses source-position order, the corresponding direction's progress difference and upward ceiling. Bidirectional travel only if an actual reverse arc exists. Equal normalized source position costs zero; distinct interior positions cost at least one tick even if u16 rounding collapses progress. Full endpoint-to-endpoint costs remain the existing core arc cost.
minimumPartialTick: Every nonempty interior road portion is charged at least one 125ms tick. This conservative approximation avoids free partial travel after prefix quantization. Primitive same-native zero steps remain offline facts; the runtime has no alias identity for independently proving a zero subportion.
pricingScope: Approximate paid partial costs from fixed simplified geometry and dual u16 source-time progress; no connector travel, source/shore/access permission or real ETA claim. Whole core weights/topology/directions/flags/turns and old vertex queries stay unchanged.
quantizationObservation: The two closed country overflow tick values are both 67268; other costs are <=65534. The maximum half-u16 source-fraction rounding is 64.153ms using the maximum 2.336-hour full encoded arc. This is saved core arithmetic, not a global snap/continuous curve/ETA bound.
controlsBeforeRouteEvaluation: Exact endpoint identities and interior quantized zero/full prefixes
Same-span direct and legal detour alternatives
Signal/blocked/forbidden-turn/U-turn behavior delegated unchanged to qualified incoming-arc search
